exercises.instruction: Закончите предложения. Некоторые из них должны быть в настоящем времени, некоторые – в прошедшем.

parts: I have to get up early tomorrow.  What time
answers: do you have to get up

parts: George had to wait a long time.  How long
Lisa has to go somewhere.  Where
We had to pay a lot of money.  How much
I have to do some work.  What exactly

exercises.instruction: Напишите предложения с don’t/doesn’t/didn’t have to … .

parts: Why are you going out? You
Why is Sue waiting? She
Why did you get up early? You
answers: didn’t have to get up early.

parts: Why is Paul working so hard? He
answers: doesn’t have to work so hard.

parts: Why do you want to leave now? We

exercises.instruction: Выберите правильный вариант. В некоторых предложениях возможны оба варианта (must или have to). В других предложениях правилен только один из них.

options: It’s a fantastic film. You must see it.
It’s a fantastic film. You have to see it.
Jessica won’t be at work this afternoon. She must go to the doctor.
Jessica won’t be at work this afternoon. She has to go to the doctor.
You can’t park your car here for nothing. You must pay.
You can’t park your car here for nothing. You have to pay.
I didn’t have any money with me last night, so I must borrow some.
I didn’t have any money with me last night, so I had to borrow some.
I eat too much chocolate. I really must stop.
I eat too much chocolate. I really have to stop.
Paul is in a hurry. He must meet somebody in five minutes.
Paul is in a hurry. He has to meet somebody in five minutes.
What’s wrong? You must tell me. I want to help you.
What’s wrong? You have to tell me. I want to help you.

exercises.instruction: Напишите несколько предложений о том, что вам (вашим друзьям или членам семьи) приходится, придётся или пришлось (с)делать.

modelAnswers: I have to travel ten miles every day.
I have to go to work every day.
I had to go to the dentist yesterday.
items.cue: Про вчерашний день: что вам пришлось сделать вчера, чего не хотелось.

modelAnswers: I have to go shopping tomorrow.
items.cue: Про завтрашний день: что вам придётся сделать завтра.

exercises.instruction: Переведите предложения на английский язык, используя have to / doesn’t have to ... . [Во сколько = What time; взять такси = take a taxi; зонттик = umbrella]

items.prompt: Завтра мне необходимо встать очень рано.
answers: I have to get up very early tomorrow.
Did you have to work yesterday?

items.prompt: Почему Вере пришлось уйти так рано?
answers: Why did Vera have to leave so early?

items.prompt: Моя бабушка вынуждена принимать это лекарство каждый день.
answers: My grandmother has to take this medicine every day.
My grandma has to take this medicine every day.

items.prompt: Во сколько ты должна быть в офисе?
answers: What time do you have to be at the office?
What time do you have to be in the office?

items.prompt: Автобус не пришёл, поэтому нам пришлось взять такси.
answers: The bus didn’t come, so we had to take a taxi.
The bus did not come, so we had to take a taxi.

items.prompt: Мне нужно покупать билет в этот музей?
answers: Do I have to buy a ticket for this museum?

items.prompt: Было солнечно, поэтому мне не пришлось брать зонттик.
answers: It was sunny, so I didn’t have to take an umbrella.
It was sunny, so I did not have to take an umbrella.
